bio: I’m Freddy Mata-Bueso, and I’m excited to join the Mather community as the Academic Coordinator. I came on board in March 2025, and I’m looking forward to getting to know all of you! I’m originally from Boston, and love everything about my city. If you ever need solid (seasoned) food recommendations/things to do in the city- I'm your guy! I’m incredibly proud of my Latinx roots, and if I’m not in the States, you’ll probably find me in Colombia. I graduated from Boston University in 2017 with a BA in Political Science and Education, and education equity is something I’m deeply passionate about. I believe in the power of education to create positive change, and that’s what drives me in my role here. Outside of work, I’m all about the art of cinema (AMC Nicole Kidman voice) , food culture, and ALL things Bad Bunny (YHLQMDLG) . I also love the idea of dogs, but like no because of commitment issues. If you ever want to talk about first-gen experience, higher education/summer internships, or just want some recommendations for a great film or food spot, I’m always happy to chat! If you ever hear my loud laugh in the dining hall, let me be, I know its loud- sorry! Community Houses Mather House Area Residential Life Role Residential Academic Coordinators
